items.headline: Man United stunned by newly promoted Hull City 2-0 in Premier League opener
items.summary: Michael Carrick's side lost 2-0 away at Hull City in the 2026-27 Premier League season opener on August 22, conceding goals from Semi Ajayi and Nobel Mendy.

items.headline: Marcus Rashford returns to squad with No. 9 shirt after Barcelona loan
items.summary: Rashford was unveiled wearing squad number 9 for 2026-27 season after loan spell at Barcelona, coming on as halftime substitute against Hull City.

items.headline: Michael Carrick: one defeat won't change United's direction
items.summary: United manager stated the team must improve but emphasized one game will not change the club's overall direction after Hull defeat.
